run_fix_boost_mpl_preprocess: run the script to fix Boost.MPL preprocessed header input files in a source directory
check_header_comment: check if a Boost.MPL header file needs its dollar Id dollar comment fixed
fix_header_comment: fix the dollar Id dollar header comment in a single file with a timestamp
check_input_files: check if Boost.MPL variadic or numbered container input files need header fixing
fix_input_files: fix all Boost.MPL preprocessed container input files by updating their header comments
